title: Blue Energy Fighter Poses
description: Four separate panels display the same female character with teal hair in dynamic action poses against a plain gray background. She wears a purple and teal outfit with a flowing cape, black gloves, and boots, surrounded by glowing cyan energy effects, swirling vortices, explosive impacts, and electric bursts.
prompt: A female character with short teal hair and glowing eyes, wearing a purple crop top, teal pants, black gloves and boots with a flowing dark cape, shown in four distinct action poses on separate panels. She manipulates bright cyan blue energy with swirling vortex effects, running with a glowing fist, striking the ground with an explosive energy burst, and standing in a combat stance, all against a neutral gray background, dynamic anime comic style.
